resources.string: Hold the button. It locks your other apps for ten minutes and pauses your distraction apps for 30, and we ride it out together.
Keep holding for a moment. It starts on a hold so a bump can\'t start it.
%1$d of the last %2$d days without a slip
No slips logged yet. Every urge you log still counts.
Nothing logged in the last 7 days.
%1$d logged: %2$d ridden out, %3$d given in to.
A slip is information, not a verdict. Answer honestly and we\'ll work out what to change.

One slip doesn\'t undo your progress, and it doesn\'t mean you\'ve failed. What matters most is the next hour: do the steps above, then go straight back to your plan. Slipping once is not a reason to slip again.
Pause my distraction apps for %1$d minutes
Déchaîner isn\'t installed on this phone.
Not allowed. Install Déchaîner first, then this app, both built with the same key.
Pauses only the apps you chose in Déchaîner, so calls, maps and banking keep working. It can add blocking, never remove it.
What are you feeling right now?
What is it pulling you toward?
How much did you sleep last night?
What was in place when it happened?
I could, but I don\'t want to
I waited for the block to end
You\'re tired or it\'s late. Self-control is at its lowest then, and the brain grabs for quick relief.
Stress is pushing you to escape. The urge is a shortcut to feeling better for a few minutes.
Boredom, or avoiding something. The urge fills the gap so you don\'t have to face it.
Loneliness. The urge is standing in for connection.
Anxiety. Your mind wants relief from the worry.
The story you\'re telling yourself is how urges win. Notice it as a story, not a fact.
Urges rise, peak and fade, usually within 10 to 20 minutes. This one will too.
Breathe slowly for one minute: in for 4, out for 6.
Stand up and leave the room you\'re in.
Splash cold water on your face, or take a cold shower.
Walk for ten minutes, ideally outside.
Message or call someone you trust, even about nothing.
Put your phone in another room and leave it there.
Do one small task for ten minutes: a few questions, tidy your desk.
If you can, go to sleep. Tomorrow\'s you will thank you.
Charge your phone outside the bedroom from tonight.
Start your evening block an hour earlier.
Extend a Déchaîner schedule to cover the hour this happened.
Cover your other devices too, or tell someone about them.
Your phone block held, so the urge went offline. Leave the room at the first sign of it, before it builds.
Fix a small start time for your hardest task, so boredom has less room.
Tell one person you trust what you\'re working on.
Move bedtime earlier; short sleep makes every urge stronger.
Say it in your own words. The more you write, the more specific your deep dive will be. Skipping is fine.
What happened, in your own words? No one is grading this.
Stays on your phone unless you use the AI deep dive.

To write your deep dive, your answers, the note you wrote, your goals text, the rules you saved and counts from your own history are sent to %1$s, the AI service you chose. Your name, contacts and other data are not sent. You can turn this off in Settings.
Add your OpenRouter key for a personal deep dive: why it\'s happening, what to do now, and what to change.
You don\'t have to face this alone
What you wrote sounds really heavy. Stay here for a moment: you matter, and this feeling is at its worst right now. It can ease, and it eases faster with someone beside you.
Call or message someone you trust now, even just \"can you call me?\". If you might hurt yourself, call your local emergency number or a crisis line.
Move away from anything you could hurt yourself with, and go where other people are.
Feet flat on the floor. Name five things you can see. Breathe out slower than you breathe in.
I\'m having a really hard time right now. Can you call me?
Save someone to call in Settings, so next time they are one tap away.
One person you trust, for a hard moment. When something you write sounds like a crisis, the journal puts them one tap away. Kept on this phone, never sent to the AI.
The reply came back in a shape I could not read. Try again.
No deep dive was saved for this one.
Bring your own key from any of these. Pasting one picks the service for you. Google AI Studio has a free tier, so you can start at no cost. There\'s no account with us and nothing in between.
Tap a suggestion below, or paste any model name your service offers.
I agree my answers and notes are sent to %1$s to write the report.

Entries are stored only on this phone. The AI deep dive is the only thing that leaves it, and only when you use it. Your key is kept encrypted in this app\'s private storage. Turn the option above off if you want to take screenshots.
This removes every entry, rule and deep dive from this phone. Your AI key and settings stay. It can\'t be undone.
OpenRouter didn\'t accept your key. Check it in Settings.
Your OpenRouter account is out of credit. Add a little and try again.
Too many requests just now. Wait a minute and try again.
Couldn\'t reach OpenRouter. Check your connection and try again.
The AI service had a problem. Try again in a moment.
The AI sent back nothing usable. Try again, or pick another model in Settings.
The base address of an OpenAI-compatible service, for example https://api.groq.com/openai/v1
That model name isn\'t available on this service. Pick one of the suggestions.
Couldn\'t load the list. Check the key and try again, or type a model name yourself.
Type part of a name, like flash, to filter. Tap one to use it.
Install Déchaîner first, so the block button has something to control.
This app can\'t reach Déchaîner yet. Reinstall this app after Déchaîner, both from the same build.
Add an AI key in Settings for the deep dive (Google AI Studio has a free tier).
What your last days show, and what to try next. Only counts and patterns are used, never your notes.
To write your weekly review, counts and patterns from your journal, including which steps worked (never your notes), are sent to %1$s, the AI service you chose. You can turn this off in Settings.
Tell the coach what matters and how to talk to you. It is added to every deep dive and weekly review, so the advice fits your real goals.
My goals and how to coach me

Your entries and your own rules live only on this phone, and uninstalling erases them. Export saves them as a file (keep it in Drive or send it to yourself). To restore, tap Import and pick that file.
Nothing new found in that backup.
Go deeper: longer, more detailed deep dives (uses a little more of your AI credit).
Show every section of a deep dive at once.
Stay with me. This will pass.
Urges rise, peak and fade, usually within about ten minutes if you don\'t feed them. You don\'t have to fight it. Just breathe and watch it.
Couldn\'t get an answer from Déchaîner. Nothing may be locked.
Déchaîner isn\'t Device Owner. Nothing is locked.
Lock active until %1$s. Calls, your alarm and this app still work.
Déchaîner didn\'t start the lock. Nothing is locked.
Your chosen distraction apps are paused until %1$s.
Your distraction apps stay paused for %1$d minutes.
I\'m through the worst of it
Still strong: keep everything locked for 30 more minutes
You started riding out an urge %1$d minutes ago. Two taps to note how it ended.
How is it going? It takes two taps.
Your tougher time of day is close. Want to pause your apps for the next hour?
Pause my apps for an hour
A rule you write yourself works better than one handed to you. Write it as \"If ..., then ...\" and it will come back the next time this kind of moment does.
Saved. It will show up the next time you ride out an urge.
If I feel %1$s%2$s, then I will
Nothing saved yet. After an urge, write an \"If ..., then ...\" rule and it will live here.
Most of your urges come between %1$s and %2$s: %3$d of your last %4$d. A heads-up before then can help you get ahead of it.
The last two weeks look heavier
That says nothing bad about you. It\'s a good moment to be kind to yourself, and to talk to someone: a friend you trust, a doctor or a counsellor. You don\'t have to sort this out alone.
Both are plain notifications that never mention what this app is for.
Check in about 20 minutes after an urge
Daily heads-up before your tough time of day
Notifications are off for this app. Turn them on in your phone\'s settings for reminders to appear.
I feel an urge: start a ride
%1$d entries in all, every one you have logged.
Tap a bar to see that day.
Tap a bar to see that week. Each label is the day the week starts.

Déchaîner bricks your phone until the time is up, breaks included: only Déchaîner, incoming calls, your alarm clock, this journal (from its Quick Settings tile) and Quick Settings keep working, plus any apps you allowed in its timer settings. Nothing ends it early, not even your recovery code, so pick a length you can keep. How many minutes?
Sent to Déchaîner. Your focus block is starting.
Went to plan: %1$d of the last %2$d days you checked in.
Sleep, study, body, people: thirty seconds.
This locks your other apps. If you didn\'t mean to start it, cancel now.
Hide the app in recent apps and block screenshots
That service address doesn\'t look right. Check it in Settings; it should start with https://.
This phone can\'t protect your key

Android\'s secure storage isn\'t working here, so your AI key can\'t be encrypted. You can keep it as plain text in this app\'s private storage, or not save it. Anyone with a copy of the app\'s files could read a plain-text key.
The AI isn\'t available right now, so these are the app\'s basic tips. Add a key in Settings or try again for a personal plan.
Tap what happened today, then how it went against your plan.
Kept. It\'s in Kept deep dives on the home screen.
Nothing kept yet. Tap \"Keep this deep dive\" under any reply you want to read again on a hard day.
No urge needed. Your week, your study, a decision, how you\'re really doing: write it the way you\'d say it to a friend who\'s on your side.
What you write here, your goals and counts from your journal (never your urge notes) are sent to %1$s to write the reply. OK?
